messages:
maria: Heads-up — found a parity gap between REST /v1/chat and the JS SDK for `function_call` handling. REST will happily accept "function_call: {name: ""}" as a string but SDK throws a 400.
aj: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro?
maria: yep — curl works: `curl -X POST /v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"call fn"}], "function_call": "auto"}'` -> returns 200 with function payload.
kevin: and the SDK?
maria: `client.chat.create({messages, function_call: "auto"})` -> 400 `invalid_parameter: function_call must be object`
aj: looks like the SDK expects an object `{mode: 'auto'}` vs the REST allowing string alias. where is this documented?
lisa: docs show both examples but the types in TypeScript definitely require `{name: string}` or `{type: 'auto'}`? that's the problem — TS defs drift.
kevin: could be historical param rename. also seeing retry semantics differ: REST retries idempotent errors with 429+Retry-After; SDK has an internal retry that swallows Retry-After and uses exponential backoff. leads to longer-than-expected delays.
maria: repro of retry mismatch: trigger quota 429 via stress test; REST client gets `Retry-After: 5` and comes back after ~5s. SDK backoffs: 1s, 2s, 4s -> ~7s before next attempt, which broke our realtime demo.
aj: that's a big DX regression. SDK should honor server Retry-After header for 429/503.
lisa: agree. SDK maintainers — @sdk-bot can you open a ticket? add note to update types and behavior.
sdk-bot: Created ticket #DX-4821: "JS SDK: align function_call param + honor Retry-After header". Assigned to @kevin. ETA 2d. :robot_face:
kevin: I'll do a patch: (1) accept string aliases for function_call, (2) relax TS union types to accept string|object, (3) change retry to prefer Retry-After when present.
maria: thanks. also found one more minor thing — REST allows bearer token in `x-api-key` header for legacy clients; SDK only supports `Authorization`. causes failures in some enterprise onboarding scripts.
aj: can we add optional header passthrough or detect `x-api-key` env var?
kevin: will add `X_API_KEY` env var support to the SDK and a compatibility flag. will include integration tests and a small sample app update.
lisa: add a note to onboarding checklist: "if using legacy x-api-key flows, set X_API_KEY env or use REST until SDK patch".
maria: good. for tracking: please post PR link in this thread when ready so CS can try with customers.
sdk-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pulls/2145 — includes tests + changelog.
aj: i'll validate with the realtime demo after deploy. ty y'all :thumbsup:
kevin: deploying patch to nightly tag now, will ping once deployed.
maria: awesome. will follow up if CS sees other drift.
